question: The Demand and Project forms use different choice lists for u_business_category (17 vs 11 values; only 2 match exactly, about 6 have a close equivalent; no HR value on projects). Which list wins?
options: (a) one merged list on both tables (b) keep two lists and map on conversion
recommendation: (a) One merged list with snake_case stored values incl. Human Resources. Fix before go-live - changing stored values later means a data-fix script
impact_if_undecided: Demand -> project conversion drops or mis-maps the category; HR projects load blank

question: How should the 18 Asana sections (HR COE areas) and the HR tracker land?
options: (a) Portfolio 'Human Resources' + one program per section (b) portfolio only; section in description (c) section -> department
recommendation: (a) HR portfolio + programs per section; merge single-item sections (Risk Mitigation; PCC/HR Committee) into a neighbour
impact_if_undecided: Programs referenced by name must exist before load or the field is blank

question: Do Asana tracker subtasks (17 rows) become WBS tasks or sub-projects? Is the Adaptive WBS in scope (the mapping sheet is header-only)?
options: (a) tasks (b) sub-projects for rows with their own PM/type
recommendation: (a) Tasks. Only the 3 vendor workstreams under Annual Enrollment have their own PM - keep them as tasks under Annual Enrollment. Adaptive: WBS for Active projects only

question: Where do Capex/Opex and the funding pool go? u_funding_type has intake choices (Opex required, Capex required, Accrete Acceleration funds Requested, other)
options: (a) OOB expense_type for Capex/Opex (b) u_funding_type (c) both
recommendation: (c) Both: expense_type (OOB, feeds financial reporting) and u_funding_type (keeps intake reports whole). Project Funding Type (19 capital pools) -> u_funding_source; make that a choice list

question: Which phase model? Adaptive: Initiation / Discovery & Design / Execution / Close Out. Asana plans: Project Initiation / Analysis/Design / Build / Test / Communicate / Train / Go-Live / Post Go-Live
options: (a) one SN phase list + template (b) per-portfolio templates
recommendation: (b) Two ServiceNow project templates (IT PMO and HR) built from these phases; map Adaptive Phase to pm_project.phase once choices exist
impact_if_undecided: phase passes through as text and is rejected by choice validation

question: I&T Integrations Needed, Strategy Focus, Strategy Timeline, HR COEs Engaged, HR Cross-Impacts, Size (projects) have no ServiceNow field
options: (a) append to description (b) create custom fields (c) drop
recommendation: (a) Append as a 'Migrated from Asana' block (already built). Create a field only for I&T Integrations if IT wants to report on it

question: Asana 'Delayed' and 'Started/Scoping' have no ServiceNow state. Asana HR items have no health fields.
options: (a) Delayed -> Work in Progress + schedule health red (b) Work in Progress only
recommendation: (a) state 2 + a migration status report with schedule = red
impact_if_undecided: Delayed items look healthy after migration

question: Entity/Organization (BSMH, RSFH, GBS, External Partners) and Adaptive Customers -> business_unit. Do these records exist?
recommendation: (a) Create BSMH / RSFH / GBS business units; External Partners -> leave blank

question: What u_demand_type do Adaptive demands get?
options: (a) New Project for all (b) New Application when Business Category = Application
recommendation: (a) unless Application-category demands follow the application intake path
impact_if_undecided: Demands route to the wrong workflow

question: Adaptive Business Sponsor is free text (may list several people). Asana HRSP / SME / Project Lead is populated on 10 of 80 rows. u_executive_sponsor has no source.
options: (a) first resolvable name -> u_business_owner; full text in description (b) leave blank
recommendation: (a) and ask sponsors to fill u_executive_sponsor after go-live
impact_if_undecided: Mandatory-field validation fails if these become required

question: Adaptive 'Dept # for Expense' (cost center table) and Asana Cost Center (blank) have no field on either form
options: (a) new u_cost_center reference to cmn_cost_center (b) department
recommendation: (a) if Finance reports by cost center; else (b)

question: Next Go-Live Date, Estimate Type, Request Received, Request Assigned, Estimate Complete, Ready For Delivery, Project Assigned have no ServiceNow field
options: (a) 7 custom fields on pm_project (and the intake ones on dmn_demand) (b) append to description (c) create a linked Completed demand holding intake dates
recommendation: (a) - these drive leadership and cycle-time reporting. Built into target_mapping as u_ fields

question: Adaptive Risk Health has no OOB project_status indicator
recommendation: (a) - one field; keeps the 6-indicator status view

question: Migrate only the latest status (Update Notes + health) or the weekly history?
recommendation: (a) latest only for Adaptive; Asana native status updates (if used) migrate in full

question: Cancelled -> skip; completed > 2 years ago -> skip; completed < 2 years -> header only. Agree?
Items routed to review: Asana Not Started with PM = TBD/N/A/blank; tracker rows with no status and no dates; Adaptive Active projects with no Ready For Delivery / Project Assigned date
impact_if_undecided: Stay in review and do not load
